lines.text: Jesus enters the temple courts, drives out the sellers, and says they have made God's house a den of robbers.
Jesus teaches at the temple every day, and the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people want to kill Him.
The chief priests and scribes with the Pharisees come to Jesus and ask by what authority He does these things.
Jesus asks whether John's baptism was from heaven or from men, and the leaders fear the people will burn them.
The leaders answer that they do not know where it was from, so Jesus will not tell them His authority.
